name: argument-parser-positive-test-e41e5b8a0a/decimal-04-v
reason: The function signature and print call are supported syntax, but the essential behavior is command-line argument conversion of the string -10.123e1423 to a decimal main parameter and its normalized decimal output. subset10 does not cover command-line argument parsing or main-entry argument conversion; support for required parameters in function signatures does not specify that runtime interface. Thus the complete case is not covered.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line argument parsing and decimal conversion for public function main(decimal d), driven by @args ["-10.123e1423"]
test_design_notes: Positive test expects -1.0123E+1424, exercising signed exponential decimal command-line input.
io:println and @output are output instrumentation, not the unsupported feature.
The numeric text occurs in an @args comment, not as a Ballerina numeric literal.
